snippet.title: Robin of Sherwood: The Touchstones of Rhiannon - RZX Playback
snippet.description:
Robin of Sherwood: The Touchstones of Rhiannon
1985 - Adventure International (UK)
ZX-Spectrum 48K - Adventure Game: Text/Illustrated

Recorded by Rafal

More info here: https://spectrumcomputing.co.uk/entry/6903/ZX-Spectrum/Robin_of_Sherwood_The_Touchstones_of_Rhiannon

We are most grateful to the late Daren Pearcy for all his work in popularising the RZX format. Without his work this project would not have been possible.
